main.name: tokimeki-space server
main.description: A Discord-like server (guild). One space per server, anchored on the owner's DID. Channels are records in the owner's repo; messages live in each author's own repo within the space. Members may also attach tokimeki-poll polls to threads: tech.tokimeki.poll.poll and tech.tokimeki.poll.vote records live in the same space and are served by the poll AppView (poll.tokimeki.tech), which the community relays writes to.
